data.navTitle: 小车模型、链条驱动与液压展示
data.title: A trolley that stops halfway

memoryNodes.cue: A tiny trolley moves and stops.
An enclosed press crushes a brittle sample.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 封闭压机压碎脆性样本。

data.situation:
A tiny trolley moved along a short track. Jo first saw a static drawing of its mechanism, then pressed the button beside a dynamic display. A chain connected the moving parts. The caption linked the trolley’s motion to kinetic energy, and a nearby board introduced kinetics as the study of motion and the forces involved. Another enclosed model used hydraulic pressure to crush a brittle sample into pieces. Halfway through the demonstration, the trolley seemed to break down and stopped. The attendant disconnected it. Maya looked at the mass and speed notes that explained momentum before the screen was switched off. Jo: Did it break down?
Attendant: It has stopped unexpectedly. We will check it before restarting.
Maya: Can the hydraulic model continue?
Attendant: That display is separate. Please stay on this side of the glass.

readingBlocks.en: A tiny trolley moved along a short track. Jo first saw a static drawing of its mechanism, then pressed the button beside a dynamic display. A chain connected the moving parts. The caption linked the trolley’s motion to kinetic energy, and a nearby board introduced kinetics as the study of motion and the forces involved. Another enclosed model used hydraulic pressure to crush a brittle sample into pieces. Halfway through the demonstration, the trolley seemed to break down and stopped. The attendant disconnected it. Maya looked at the mass and speed notes that explained momentum before the screen was switched off.
readingBlocks.zh: 一辆极小的小车沿短轨道行驶。乔先看机械结构静图，再按动态图旁的按钮。链条连接运动部件。字幕把小车运动与动能联系，邻板介绍动力学，即研究运动及相关力的学科。另一封闭模型用液压把脆性样本压成碎块。演示到半途，小车似乎故障停下，工作人员断开它。屏幕关闭前，玛雅查看解释动量的质量和速度说明。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Did it break down?
Attendant: It has stopped unexpectedly. We will check it before restarting.
Maya: Can the hydraulic model continue?
Attendant: That display is separate. Please stay on this side of the glass.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：它故障了吗？
工作人员：它意外停了，我们会检查后再启动。
玛雅：液压模型能继续吗？
工作人员：那是独立展示，请留在玻璃这边。

glossary.note: 非常小的；a tiny part，一个极小的零件。
glossary.example: A tiny trolley moved along the track.
glossary.exampleZh: 极小的小车沿轨道移动。

glossary.zh: 不运动或不变化的；静态的
glossary.note: 这里表示静止；a static image，静态图像。

glossary.zh: 涉及运动或变化的；动态的
glossary.note: 这里描述运动或变化中的展示，与 static 对照。
glossary.example: The dynamic display showed moving parts.
glossary.exampleZh: 动态展示显示运动部件。

externalEvidence.label: Collins English Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Motion/change adjective, not only vigorous personality.

glossary.zh: 由相连金属环组成的链条
glossary.note: 这里是实体链条；a metal chain。
glossary.example: A chain connected the moving parts.

externalEvidence.definition: a series of (usually metal) rings or links fitted into one another to make a flexible ligament
relating to the motion of material bodies and the forces associated therewith

glossary.zh: 研究运动及其相关力的动力学
glossary.note: 研究运动及相关力的学科；动能应说 kinetic energy。

externalEvidence.definition: the branch of mechanics concerned with the forces that cause motions of bodies

glossary.zh: 通过液体压力运作的；液压的
glossary.note: 由液体压力驱动的，如 hydraulic brakes。
glossary.example: The enclosed model used hydraulic pressure.

externalEvidence.definition: moved or operated or effected by liquid (water or oil)

glossary.zh: 用力压使某物破碎；压碎
glossary.note: 这里表示施压至破碎；crush something into small pieces。
glossary.example: The press crushed a brittle sample into pieces.
glossary.exampleZh: 压机把脆性样本压成碎块。

glossary.note: 这里是物理动量，即质量与速度的乘积；日常也可指发展势头。
glossary.example: The notes related momentum to mass and velocity.
glossary.exampleZh: 说明把动量与质量和速度联系起来。

externalEvidence.definition: the product of a body's mass and its velocity

glossary.zh: 机器停止正常运作；发生故障
glossary.note: 机器或车辆出故障：the machine broke down。
glossary.example: The trolley appeared to break down.
